{{ModBox}}
'''Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation''' is the [[Prime]]d version of the {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} [[mod]] for secondaries, which converts any unused Primary [[Ammo]] into Secondary Ammo. The affected pistol will only convert ammo while equipped, and will '''not''' convert any ammo type used by [[holster]]ed primary weapons until their own ammo is full.

Converted ammo is denoted by a {{Icon|Item|Mutate}} symbol. The final amount of ammo restored is rounded to the nearest integer.

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased <u>unranked</u> from the Void Trader [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|140,000}} and {{dc|400}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time.

==Tips==
*Highly recommended for ammo inefficient weapons such as the {{Weapon|Dex Furis}} or {{Weapon|Twin Vipers Wraith}}.
*Functions well with [[Robotic]] companion's {{M|Vacuum}}, {{Companion|Chesa Kubrow}}'s {{M|Retrieve}}, and/or [[Beast]] companion's {{M|Fetch}}, which automatically collect unused ammo as needed.

{{ver|15.13}}

}}

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased <u>unranked</u> from the Void Trader [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|220,000}} and {{dc|400}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time.
{{clr}}

==Notes==
*'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is additive with similar mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Sicarus}} with a max rank '''{{PAGENAME}}''' and {{M|Hydraulic Crosshairs}} will have a {{Math|16% {{mul}} (1 + 187% + 135%)|t=y|p=y}} critical chance.
*Cannot be equipped with {{M|Creeping Bullseye}}.
*Unlike most Primed mods, Primed Pistol Gambit offers less [[critical chance]] per rank than its normal version, giving only 17% per rank compared to Pistol Gambit's 20%. However, Primed Pistol Gambit has a higher maximum rank along with a lower overall mod cost for similar benefits.
**At the cost of needing more [[Endo]] in order to upgrade this mod, Primed Pistol Gambit boasts a better [[critical chance]] to drain ratio.
***For example, at base rank, Pistol Gambit supplies 20% [[critical chance]] for 4 drain while Primed Pistol Gambit at rank 2 grants 51% [[critical chance]] at the same 4 drain.
**Had Primed Pistol Gambit followed Pistol Gambit's format, it would have had 220% [[critical chance]] at the cost of 14 drain.

==Tips==
*Can be combined with {{M|Hydraulic Crosshairs}} for a total increase of '''+322%''' after getting a shot to an enemy's head. This allows the {{Weapon|Akmagnus}}, {{Weapon|Lex Prime}}, {{Weapon|Spira}}, and {{Weapon|Twin Grakatas}} to gain a [[critical chance]] of '''105.5%''', guaranteeing crits.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|16.10.1}}
*Fixed incorrect stats showing on the Primed Pistol Gambit Mod in the Arsenal - it now has the proper base of 17% chance increase, leading to a possible 187% when fully ranked.

{{ver|16.10}}
*Introduced to Baro Ki'Teer's rotation.
}}

==See Also==
*{{M|Pistol Gambit}}, the normal version.
*{{M|Primed Pressure Point}}, another Primed mod with reduced effect per rank.

==Acquisition==
*This mod is exclusive to the [[Daily Tribute]] system. It will become available at day 200, 400, 600 and 900, until chosen as the Milestone reward, among {{M|Primed Vigor}}, {{M|Primed Fury}}, and (day 400+) {{M|Primed Sure Footed}}.
**This mod first became available on July 24, 2017 UTC.
**As with other Daily Tribute rewards, it can '''not''' be traded.

==Notes==
*This mod is significantly more powerful than its normal counterpart when stacking a maxed {{M|Metal Auger}}, increasing overall punch-through up to 4.3.
*The fire rate boost increases [[Fire Rate#Charged Weapons|charging speed]] of chargeable weapons and the drawing speed of Bow class weapons.
**Bows receive double the fire rate increase from this mod unlike other primary weapons.
*Primed Shred costs slightly more than {{M|Metal Auger}}, but gives a slightly higher [[punch through]] bonus along with a fire rate bonus.
**In a matching polarity mod slot, both Metal Auger ({{Pol|Naramon}}) and Primed Shred ({{Pol|Madurai}}) will cost 8 capacity.

==Trivia==
*This is the second Primed mod to be based on a [[:Category:Nightmare_Mode_Mods|Nightmare Mod]], following {{M|Primed Vigor}} which is also limited to the Daily Tribute system.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|

**Daily Tribute Milestone Login Rewards these were already untradeable, we’ve just also made them unsellable from Inventory: 
***Primed Shred
}}

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased '''unranked''' from the Void Trader [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|220,000}} and {{dc|300}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time.

==Notes==
*Bonus stacks additively with {{Arcane|Secondary Deadhead}} and {{M|Strafing Slide}}'s recoil reduction.
**Can add with other sources to go beyond -100% recoil, which can be useful to negate [[Riven Mods|Riven]] mod effect.
*This mod reduces the distance the aiming reticle is shaken when fired, however, it doesn't help increase gun base accuracy.
*Affects vertical, horizontal, and other recoil patterns.

==Tips==
*In rough order, the {{Weapon|Akjagara}}, {{Weapon|Aklex}}, {{Weapon|Akvasto}}, {{Weapon|Lex}}, {{Weapon|Magnus}}, {{Weapon|Seer}}, {{Weapon|Vasto}} and {{Weapon|Zakti}} benefit effectively from this mod, especially when increasing their fire rate with mods.
*Has no effect on the {{Weapon|Spectra}}, {{Weapon|Embolist}}, or other beam-type weapons, as they have no recoil.
